entities.name: Adélaïde Labille-Guiard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adélaïde Labille-Guiard, also known as Adélaïde Labille-Guiard des Vertus, was a French miniaturist and portrait painter. She was an advocate for women to receive the same opportunities as men to become great painters. Labille-Guiard was one of the first women to become a member of the Royal Academy, and was the first female artist to receive permission to set up a studio for her students at the Louvre.

She was an advocate for women to receive the same opportunities as men to become great painters.
